text: In the 6000-step N=64 m2-fixed runs, seed 21's force best layer moves from layer 1 to layer 4 at step 4000 and keeps rising (+0.004-0.005 margin per 500 steps). Seed 20 stays at layer 1 and levels off (+0.009 from step 3000 to 6000). At step 6000, what is seed 20's layer-4 force R2? Is late force growth at N=64 carried only by a layer-4 code that seed 20 never develops?
